problem_statement: Add a message-based Bottom Half Processor API, available through bhp/msg.h, that lets an ISR request bottom-half work for a configured callback by sending a message to a claimed thread. A bhp_msg_t descriptor must be initialized with a callback and context: after bhp_msg_init, bhp_msg.pid is KERNEL_PID_UNDEF, bhp_msg.bhp.irq_handler is the callback, bhp_msg.bhp.ctx is the context, and bhp_msg.msg.type is BHP_MSG_BH_REQUEST. bhp_msg_claim_thread must set bhp_msg.pid to the target thread. bhp_msg_isr_cb must, given a pointer to an initialized bhp_msg_t, cause the claimed thread to be able to receive a message of type BHP_MSG_BH_REQUEST, and bhp_msg_handler must, when given such a message, verify its type is BHP_MSG_BH_REQUEST and run the configured bottom-half callback with its context.

verification.reason: The problem statement fully specifies the bhp_msg_t struct fields (pid, bhp.irq_handler, bhp.ctx, msg.type), all four functions (bhp_msg_init, bhp_msg_claim_thread, bhp_msg_isr_cb, bhp_msg_handler) with their parameters and observable behaviour, the BHP_MSG_BH_REQUEST constant, and the header path bhp/msg.h. The hidden tests only exercise these described behaviours, and the module name bhp_msg is derivable from the header path under RIOT's standard conventions.
